selected.primary_estimand: Within each muscle (plantaris, soleus): transcriptome response to 3 d hindlimb immobilisation (disuse atrophy) in each endurance-trainability line (HIinLRT, HIinHRT), and the line difference in that response (DELTA = HIinLRT - HIinHRT, a line x treatment interaction). The 8-week endurance training at ~12 weeks only phenotyped the breeding lines; all sequenced rats are 14 months old and there is no trained-vs-sedentary contrast in the sequenced samples. 'Exercise' enters as the genetic endurance-trainability line (associational).
exploratory_contrasts: LRT vs HRT within CTRL and within HI, per muscle (associational, genotype)

decisions.reason: GSE159861 is the paper's deposit (S7.p1). 2x2 between-animal design line (HRT/LRT) x treatment (CTRL/HI), n=6 per cell, in two muscles. Planned per muscle: HIinLRT, HIinHRT, DELTA (S2.2.p2). Two thresholds stated: FDR<0.001 (S2.2.p2) and logFC>1 & FDR<0.05 (S3.5.p1, FIG2); the counts are reported under the latter, so it is the paper_threshold.
